newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shun Tak says accepts land premium. [CORRECTED 15:42 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Shun Tak says accepts land premium. [CORRECTED 15:42 GMT]

text.p: Shun Tak Holdings Ltd said on Monday it had accepted the government's proposed land premium of HK$4.9 billion for its Belcher Gardens project.

"After careful consideration, and as supported by recent rising residential property selling trends, Shun Tak finally agreed to pay the government a premium of HK$373 million for the modification of restriction on alienation and a redevelopment premium of HK$4.9 billion (corrects from "HK$4.9 million") for the Belcher Gardens site," it said in a statement.
The project is 51 percent held by Shun Tak, 29 percent by Sun Hung kai Properties Ltd and 10 percent each by New World Development Co Ltd and Liu Chong Hing Investment Ltd.
